newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices mixed at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices mixed at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were mixed at the weekly auction in Mombasa, auction officials said on Monday.
Brighter BP1s shed 3-5 U.S. cents while Brighter PF1s lost 6-14 cents. Lower medium PF1s were steady while Brighter PDUSTs shed up to 12 cents. Lower medium PDUSTs were firm by five cents.
The secondary teas sold at firm rates.
Pakistani blenders were strong buyers, as was Egypt, while Britain showed improved but selective interest.
